title: BREAKING: Israel Escobedo Jr. arrested on felony drug charge
excerpt: Israel Escobedo Jr. was booked into the Webb County Jail on Oct. 24 on an alleged state jail felony charge of possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2, under 1 gram, plus a DWI count. Bond was not set.
content:
LAREDO — A 27-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail early Saturday morning on an alleged felony drug charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Israel Escobedo Jr. was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 3:20 a.m. by the Texas Department of Public Safety. The booking record lists possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2, under 1 gram — a state jail felony — and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was not set on either charge.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
